metaShifts.description: Khanda receives a net positive change (-100 cost, -15% spell damage) making it more accessible while still powerful. This creates a new hybrid carry archetype that combines right-click damage with spell amplification. The cost reduction makes it viable earlier in the game, while the damage reduction prevents it from being overpowered late game.

Anti-Mage (+2 base strength), Juggernaut (Blade Fury -6s early cooldown), Phantom Lancer (Phantom Rush +0.5s duration), and Sven (multiple buffs) receive significant early-game improvements. This reverses the Gleipnir utility carry meta by strengthening heroes who build traditional carry items and rely on farming patterns rather than utility.

Following 7.37d's Gleipnir termination, this patch continues the intelligence core purge: Shadow Fiend Necromastery damage gutted (-1 damage per soul at all levels), Invoker multiple nerfs (EMP, Cold Snap), Puck damage reduction. Only OD receives a minor buff. This completes the transition away from spell-based cores.

Support heroes receive nuanced adjustments that increase skill requirements: Shadow Shaman mana cost rescaling, Bane Enfeeble scaling changes, multiple talent reworks. This builds on 7.37d's support item collapse by making support play more mechanically demanding while providing fewer item-based power spikes.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Sven's Vanquisher damage increase (+3%) and God's Strength mana cost reduction combine perfectly with Khanda's cost reduction. Sven can now afford Khanda earlier while his enhanced damage scaling makes the spell amplification more impactful on Storm Hammer and Warcry.

Anti-Mage's +2 base strength improves his notorious early game weakness, making him more viable in the current meta that favors traditional farming carries over utility-based ones. This synergizes with the death of Gleipnir meta, as AM never built utility items anyway.

Blade Fury cooldown reduction (42→36s at level 1) enables much more frequent early game rotations and fights. This synergizes perfectly with the weakened support itemization from 7.37d, as supports have fewer defensive tools to deal with Juggernaut's enhanced early presence.

WK's +2 base armor buff continues the strength core ascendancy from 7.37d. His natural tankiness and traditional item builds (no Gleipnir dependency) make him perfectly positioned in a meta where supports lack defensive items and intelligence cores are weakened.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: SF's Necromastery damage nerf (-1 damage per soul) is devastating when combined with 7.37d's Gleipnir elimination. SF relied on both high base damage scaling and Gleipnir for farming/teamfighting, and now has neither. The Feast of Souls changes don't compensate for the core damage loss.

Multiple Invoker nerfs (EMP pull speed, Cold Snap mana cost) compound with the broader intelligence core dismantling. Invoker's complex spell combinations become less rewarding when the entire spell-based mid archetype is being systematically weakened.

Heroes like Enchantress (Enchant +30 mana cost, Nature's Attendants duration nerf) and Bounty Hunter (Shuriken +10-15 mana cost) face increased mana constraints precisely when 7.37d eliminated their item-based mana solutions through Arcane Boots and Guardian Greaves nerfs.

Medusa's Venomous Volley no longer applying from illusions eliminates synergy with illusion-based items and strategies. Combined with Mana Shield damage reduction, this removes her from both traditional carry and utility carry archetypes.

Carry.explanation: Base strength increase (+2) significantly improves his early game survivability, the traditional weakness that prevented him from competing with utility carries. With Gleipnir meta dead, his traditional farming pattern and item builds become meta-relevant again.

Blade Fury cooldown reduction (42→36s level 1) enables much more aggressive early rotations and farming patterns. His traditional carry build path benefits from the shift away from utility-based carries.

Multiple buffs (Vanquisher +3% damage, God's Strength mana reduction) combined with Khanda cost reduction create a powerful hybrid carry build. His strength scaling aligns with the continued strength core dominance from 7.37d.

Phantom Rush duration increase (+0.5s) improves his chase potential and teamfight mobility. As a traditional agility carry who never relied on Gleipnir, he benefits from the meta shift toward conventional carry itemization.

Mid.explanation: Ominous Discernment mana scaling increase (2→2.5 per Intelligence) provides significant late-game power scaling. As one of the few intelligence mids to receive buffs, he becomes a rare viable spell-based core option.

Offlane.explanation: Base armor increase (+2) enhances his already strong laning presence. His traditional strength-based itemization and natural tankiness align perfectly with the strength core ascendancy trend from previous patches.

Anchor Smash mana cost reduction (45→40 level 1) improves his laning sustainability and farming efficiency. His role as a traditional strength initiator benefits from the weakened support defensive items.
Base intelligence increase (+2) and Drunken Brawler armor buffs improve both his laning and teamfight presence. His natural tankiness and traditional item builds fit the current meta direction.

SoftSupport.explanation: Base attack speed increase (+10) significantly improves his laning and pushing capabilities. The Hex mana rescaling provides better early-game efficiency when support items are weakened.

Fiery Soul Aghanim's Shard buff (+5 spell damage per charge) enhances her transition to a semi-core role. Her ability to scale independently of support items makes her viable in the current support ecosystem.

HardSupport.explanation: Weave duration increase (8→10s) provides significantly more teamfight impact and utility. His armor manipulation becomes more valuable when teams have fewer defensive items overall.
Decay base damage increase (+10 at all levels) improves his laning presence and early game impact. His strength-based scaling aligns with the overall strength hero dominance trend.

Carry.explanation: Venomous Volley illusion interaction removal eliminates synergy with illusion-based carry builds, while Mana Shield damage reduction (2.4→2.2) weakens her core defensive mechanism. She loses viability in both traditional and utility carry archetypes.

Reflection mana cost increase (+10-15 at all levels) significantly impacts his early game trading and farming efficiency. His illusion-based playstyle becomes less effective with the overall meta shift toward direct damage dealers.

Mid.explanation: Necromastery damage reduction (-1 per soul at all levels) is catastrophic for his core scaling mechanism. Combined with 7.37d's Gleipnir elimination, he loses both his farming tool and damage scaling, making him completely unviable as a mid core.

Multiple nerfs (EMP pull speed reduction, Cold Snap +10 mana cost) compound his complexity with reduced effectiveness. The systematic intelligence core dismantling makes his spell-based approach increasingly unrewarding.
Puckish spell dodge reduction (4x→3.5x) and talent damage nerf (-10 Orb damage) weaken both his survivability and damage output. The intelligence core purge continues to target spell-based mids.

Offlane.explanation: Drums of Slom damage reduction (-5) and talent nerf (Magic Resist 10%→8%) weaken his teamfight contribution. His utility-based approach becomes less effective in a meta favoring direct damage and tankiness.

Battery Assault creep damage reduction (2x→1.5x) significantly impacts his farming efficiency and lane clear. The talent rework removes his mobility options, making him less effective as a tempo-controlling offlaner.

SoftSupport.explanation: Enchant mana cost standardization to 70 (from 40/50/60/70) and Nature's Attendants duration nerf create severe early game mana constraints. With support items weakened from 7.37d, she lacks the mana pool to function effectively.

Shuriken Toss mana cost increase (+10-15 at all levels) creates significant early game mana pressure. His roaming playstyle becomes unsustainable when combined with the weakened support item ecosystem from previous patches.

HardSupport.explanation: Base intelligence reduction (-1) directly impacts his mana pool and spell damage scaling. In an environment where support items provide less mana sustain, this base stat nerf becomes particularly punishing for his spell-heavy playstyle.
Voodoo Switcheroo duration reduction (3→2.5s) weakens his teamfight control and save potential. The shorter duration makes the ability less reliable for protecting cores in extended fights.
